phases.objective: Bind Migration 1050 to its final merged source identity and provide separate Production-safe readiness, exactly-once Apply, and verification phases without retrying Migration 1049 or applying the live GitHub Ruleset.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Readiness fails closed until Production contains source merge 5505adde1bf29125c56d8588cf8de3ee956c819c and exact blob 571fab72a305a209fa19e7b0711d87cd4eae483c; raw bytes are checksum-bound before dry-run, Apply is separately confirmed and invoked at most once, and verification proves the repaired Repository Policy Controller metadata while Migration 1049 retry and live GitHub Ruleset Apply remain prohibited.
steps: Resolve PR 6629 and require its merge commit to equal the canonical Migration 1050 source merge.
Require current Production to contain that source merge and the exact Migration 1050 Git blob before readiness can proceed.
Decode GitHub Contents base64 to raw bytes, reproduce the Git blob SHA, compute SHA-256 directly over those bytes, and require exactly seven SQL statements.
Prove Runtime version and deployment-info converge to the exact stable Production SHA.
Create checksum-bound migration authorization, execute dry-run only, and verify one durable authorization row during readiness.
Require a distinct Migration 1050 Apply command, same-cycle dry-run, an apply-authorized migration capability envelope, and exactly one Apply transport invocation.
Never retry after ambiguous Apply transport; reconcile through exact migration ledger and read-only metadata readback.
Verify the five canonical repository-policy registration surfaces plus authorization metadata and keep live GitHub policy apply false.
assertions: The producer has contents: read only, persist-credentials=false, and cannot mutate Issues.
Production missing the source merge or exact blob fails closed before authorization or dry-run.
SHA-256 is computed from decoded raw GitHub bytes and those bytes must reproduce the pinned Git blob SHA.
Migration 1049 is never invoked or retried by this lifecycle.
Apply contains exactly one governed_migration_execute Apply transport call and records apply_retried=false.
The migration-specific confirmation is distinct from APPLY_GITHUB_MAIN_REVIEW_POLICY.
Post-Apply verification is read-only and proves single-owner metadata, tool/capability/binding/export registration, and live_github_policy_apply=false.
No provider mutation, live GitHub Ruleset mutation, Production ref mutation, force push, credential payload publication, or external business write is introduced.
